decisions: Minutes of the September 21, 2025 board meeting approved as presented.
Q3 2025 financial results accepted; CFO Pierre Dubois mandated to deliver a Q1 2026 cash flow mitigation plan by November 15, 2025.

Negotiation team (Aiyana Park and Pierre Dubois) authorized to finalize Acme Corp contract renewal, accepting a maximum 3% base retainer reduction contingent on inclusion of expanded scope services at market rates; contract to be executed no later than January 15, 2026.
Phase 2 of the Operational Efficiency Initiative approved with a budget of $215,000; vendor selection to be completed by November 30, 2025, with implementation commencing January 2026.
Recruitment authorized for one Senior ESG Consultant and one Business Development Director, with target onboarding by March 31, 2026.
Next board meeting confirmed for November 23, 2025 at 10:00 AM.
